summary:
This PR makes local web, API, and Playwright ports configurable so parallel worktrees can run without port collisions while preserving loopback-only defaults.
- Derives API CORS defaults from `WEB_PORT` while preserving explicit `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`.
- Configures Vite development and preview servers through `WEB_PORT`.
- Propagates configurable web and API URLs through Playwright and E2E helpers.
- Updates development analytics requests to honor `VITE_API_URL` and use the API port by default.
